NBA DFS Picks for Thursday, October 22 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Thursday, October 22 · 2 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 22, 4:17 PM ET

Nikola Jokic (DEN) is the top-projected player on the Thursday, October 22 DraftKings main slate at 59.6 DraftKings points for $10,900. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 51.0, $9,900) and Joel Embiid (PHI, 43.0, $7,700) are next.

Chet Holmgren (OKC) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.88 projected points per $1,000 at $5,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 22, 4:17 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
